headline: Toyota Raises Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027; Impact of Kumamoto Earthquake Under Review
summary: Toyota raised its consolidated earnings forecast for the year ending March 2027, citing a weaker yen assumption and a new Middle East logistics route. Operating profit is now expected 400 billion yen higher than in May.
why: Toyota is Japan's largest automaker and a bellwether for the global auto sector and the yen's impact on exporters.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor
impacts.why: A raised full-year earnings forecast directly signals higher expected profit.
